summary: POET TECHNOLOGIES filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 19,047,620 common shares and warrants to purchase 19,047,620 common shares at a combined price of $21.00 per unit. Warrants are exercisable at $26.25 per share for three years. The offering price represents a 31.5% premium over the $15.97 closing price on May 15, 2026. No placement agent fees are payable. Delivery is expected on May 18, 2026. This is a conventional equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for dilution from the warrants, but no risk-arb angle.
